limits: Consumes most of the budget and depends on key reading; score ties are insufficient.
operation: Refresh, reselect intended key, then commit each correction.
probe: Charge three actions per target and finish with the latest snapshot.
relation: Reselection after sorting can repair stale selection while maintaining frequent freshness.

limits: Targets are source-independent here; changing targets or deletions may defeat batching.
operation: Batch corrections from S0, then refresh once.
probe: Perform three select/commit pairs, then refresh; check actual keys and S2.
relation: Deferring reordering can stabilize positions while preserving final freshness.

limits: Detection is scripted, not measured human capability; inspection consumes budget.
operation: Inspect immutable key immediately before row-bound commit.
probe: Replay O5 with an extra inspection; log detection, reselection and cost.
relation: Identity checking can detect a different record occupying the selected row.
